home.title: DevExtreme multi-calendar
home.heading: DevExtreme in three calendars
home.lede: A fork of DevExtreme whose date components display, accept and group dates in the Gregorian, Persian (Jalali) and Arabic (Hijri) calendars. Pick a calendar and a language at the top; every demo follows them.
home.api.title: One option per widget
home.api.hint: The stored value is the same Date in every calendar
